assertions.text: Response reads the existing rule file before editing it
The new case is appended to the appropriate section rather than replacing existing Incorrect/Correct examples
Existing content (the original scratch-file cases) is preserved, not rewritten or dropped
Response states or shows evidence of re-running the redundancy filter after the addition
Response states or shows evidence of re-running the security self-check on the updated file
Response states or shows evidence of re-confirming with /rules-review that the updated rule still fires correctly
